scope: Real CLI create/no-op acceptance; not replacement or recovery acceptance

distributions.python_source_tree_digest_format: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON mapping package-relative .py paths to file SHA-256 values
distributions.note: Hashes identify the exact tested archives, not a claim that later documentation-only builds reproduce those archives byte-for-byte.

runtime_build.entrypoint: Installed CLI: streamt -o json runtime build --timeout 600
runtime_build.note: Installed build used local Docker cache. Source-context parity is verified; identical final image/JAR bytes across independent builds are not promised.

existing_journey: Import preview, import and repeated preview use the real CLI.
Imported input remains external; missing discovered schema is reported, then columns are explicitly declared locally.
Repeated preview does not overwrite enriched source declarations.
External input topic ID and configuration remain unchanged after apply.
Lineage connects declared producer application, imported source, managed SQL model and declared consumer application.
Default health status does not observe the external source.
Two managed state records exist: output topic and SQL runner.
fresh_journey: The real init --executor kafka_streams creates the starter without provider access.
The generated project is used without editing its intended specification.
Lineage connects managed raw_orders, managed eligible_orders and metadata-only fraud_app.
Three managed state records exist: input topic, output topic and SQL runner.
both_journeys: Strict validation, lineage, dry compilation and offline plan succeed with provider construction, sockets and subprocesses forbidden.
Missing consumed column and incompatible known consumed type each reject real online plan and apply before provider access or file mutation.

Invalid internal bootstrap URL rejects online plan and apply with no changes to Kafka topics/UUIDs/configuration/partitions/groups, owned Docker containers/volumes, declarations or .streamt state/control/private files.
Rejected apply may regenerate local generated/ compilation artifacts; that established behavior is not treated as provider or state mutation.
Docker container snapshots preserve all fields and canonicalize only the unordered Mounts array by destination.
Compiled artifacts contain topics and one Kafka Streams job, no Flink jobs or schemas.
Actual online plan and apply create the topology and report a running owned container.
Runner 0.1.1 running status passes exact verified cluster/input/output identity checks.
Five input records exercise threshold filtering, boolean filtering, a nullable amount and a tombstone.
A read_committed consumer receives exactly one JSON output: id=a, amount=120, with original raw key bytes 00ff.
The SQL application's committed input offset reaches 5.
Second online plan reports no changes; second actual apply keeps the same container and committed progress.
topic_config_reconciliation: Real native SDK reports explicit retention.ms source as integer 1 and inherited min.insync.replicas source as integer 3 with is_default=false.
Inherited broker configuration is not proposed for removal.
A disposable topic's genuine retention.ms override is removed using Kafka DELETE and then plans as unchanged.

cleanup_per_run.scope: Only exact generated application/container/volume/network identities with verified ownership labels

limits: No Kafka Streams replacement, restart, rollback, checkpoint recovery, retention-loss recovery or exactly-once recovery guarantee is accepted by these create/no-op journeys.
Custom application declarations describe dependencies and contracts; streamt does not schedule the custom application. The test runs its own consumer.
Acceptance uses one local Docker broker, one partition per topic and plaintext networking; it does not prove live SASL/TLS, remote Docker, multi-broker or multi-partition operation.
Fresh broker group-coordinator readiness is awaited with read-only describe calls before apply. NOT_COORDINATOR was observed; offset writes were not retried or reset.

The zero-file-write guarantee applies to coherence-validation failures. Runtime-initialization refusal preserves declarations and .streamt state/control/private files, but apply may already have regenerated generated/ artifacts.
Fixtures explicitly assign unique cluster IDs; Apache Kafka image defaults otherwise reuse a fixed ID across independent disposable brokers.
Image building is an explicit operation allowed to access dependency/base-image networks. Init, offline commands and ordinary apply do not implicitly build or pull images.
Raw logs, local endpoints and temporary host paths are retained only in local run evidence, not in this curated record.
